LanguageData.WotF_Stat_StaffWielding_Desc: A one-handed offhand wand does not occupy the primary weapon slot: it auto-casts when carried alone or fires manually alongside a primary weapon. A two-handed main-hand staff occupies the primary slot for full reach and higher material resonance caps.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_StaffAllowsSuper_Desc: Whether this focus can channel super runes. Only two-handed spell staves can anchor super runes.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_StaffAllowsShieldBelt_Desc: Whether this focus can cast while wearing a shield belt that blocks ranged weapons. One-handed wands cast freely through shield belts; two-handed staves are blocked.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_StaffRangeFactor_Desc: Multiplier applied to the aim range of projectile and touch spells cast through this focus (Self, Orbit and Super spells are unaffected).
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_StaffWindupFactor_Desc: Multiplier applied to spell windup time when casting through this focus; lower values cast sooner.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_StaffDamageFactor_Desc: Multiplier applied to the damage of spells cast through this focus. Derived from the material's sharp and blunt damage multipliers (base spell power {0}, cap {1}).
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_StaffManaFactor_Desc: Multiplier applied to the mana cost of spells cast through this focus. Higher material blunt armor lowers the mana cost (minimum {0}).
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_StaffDurationFactor_Desc: Multiplier applied to the duration of status effects and fields cast through this focus. Higher material heat armor extends duration (cap {0}).
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_StaffNoMaterial: No material selected (showing baseline focus values).
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_SpellbookMaxGlyphs_Desc: Maximum number of runes in a single spell chain while wearing this book. All ten bookmarks stay open; swapping to a lower-tier book keeps longer spells intact until a higher-tier book is worn.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_SpellbookSuperGlyphs_Desc: Whether this spellbook can hold super runes. Casting a super spell also requires holding a spell staff.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_EnchantSlots_Desc: Number of reactive spells that can be inscribed onto this item at a ritual altar. Standard materials hold {0}; {1} opens {2} slots.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_EnchantTriggerChance_Desc: Chance for the active inscribed spell to fire when this weapon lands a hit or this apparel's wearer is struck by an attacker.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_EnchantTriggerCooldown_Desc: Minimum time between consecutive reactive spell triggers from this item.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_EnchantMithrilCost_Desc: Mana cost multiplier applied to reactive spells triggered by this {0} item.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_TerrainStride_Desc: On passable cells that do not require opening a door, removes movement penalties from terrain, plants, rock chunks, furniture, crossable workbenches, snow and sand.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_ManaVialRestore_Desc: Amount of personal bloodline mana restored immediately when consumed by a forest-blooded pawn.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_ManaLinkRadius_Desc: Maximum distance to connect to nearby mana nodes in a mana network.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_ManaCapacity_Desc: Maximum amount of network mana this vessel can store.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_ManaOutput_Desc: Rate at which this building supplies mana to its connected mana network while operating.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_ManaOutputCap_Desc: Maximum mana per second drawn from mature trees within range ({0} / s per unit of tree growth).
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_ManaPlantRadius_Desc: Radius for both drawing ambient mana from standing trees and connecting to a mana node.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_ManaPlantMinGrowth_Desc: Minimum growth required for a tree inside the radius to contribute mana.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_ManaDraw_Desc: Network mana drawn per second while a pawn is actively crafting at this bench.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_TurretManaFactor_Desc: Multiplier applied to the inscribed spell's mana cost when fired from the mana network.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_TurretInscriptionTime_Desc: Work time needed to inscribe a new projectile spell into this turret.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_AltarTier_Desc: Highest ritual tier that can be hosted on this altar.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_AltarHelperFactor_Desc: Share of each helper's bloodline chant power added to the host's chant power during rituals.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_GateUpkeep_Desc: Network mana consumed per second while the gate is kept open.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_GateRemoteCost_Desc: Mana drawn from the network for one remote transfer: {0} base fee, plus {1} per pawn and {2} per kilogram of cargo.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_GateArrivalRadius_Desc: Radius around this gate within which arriving pawns and items are placed.
LanguageData.WotF_Stat_GateRuinedMode_Desc: This ruined gate requires no local mana network and collapses immediately after sending a caravan home to an open colony gate.
